name: IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited
about: IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited engages in the infrastructure development in India. It operates through Built, Operate and Transfer (BOT)/Toll, Operate and Transfer (TOT); InvITs & Related Assets; and Construction segments. The company is involved in the operation and maintenance of roads; airport development; development of highways; investment in units of IRB Infrastructure Trust, IRB InvIT Fund, and other related assets; and real estate activities. It also engages in construction, tolling, operations and maintenance activities in its portfolio of BOT, TOT, and hybrid annuity model projects. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Mumbai, India.
